# 21cm Cosmic Dawn Atlas — Unified Visualization Portal

> Interactive cosmological visualization suite by Haina Huang (CUHK Astrophysics) covering precomputed 21cmFAST simulations, 3D reionization volumes, and PSX-emu v1.0 surrogate/posterior results.

## Views
1. **Parameter & 2D Slice Atlas** (`https://hainahuang729.github.io/21cm-cosmic-dawn-atlas/`):
   - 55 exact broken-power-law (BPL) and 32 matched power-law (PL) 21cmFAST simulations in 250 cMpc boxes (256^3 grid).
   - Interactive brightness-temperature lightcones (z = 35 to z = 6), global signal δT_b(z), reionization history ξ(z) & τ_e, HST/JWST UV luminosity functions, and on-demand 32-redshift 2D spatial slices across 5 physical fields.
2. **3D Glow Volume Explorer** (`https://hainahuang729.github.io/21cm-cosmic-dawn-atlas/portal/cavity.html`):
   - Real-time WebGL volume renderer publishing all 85 validated PL and BT redshift snapshots for neutral hydrogen (xH), 128^3 density contrast, and 21 cm brightness temperature with per-frame SHA-256 verification.
3. **PSX-emu v1.0 Emulator & Posteriors** (`https://hainahuang729.github.io/21cm-cosmic-dawn-atlas/emulator/`):
   - Visual gallery of the 100k-sample reionization history & 21 cm power-spectrum surrogate (`PSX-emu v1.0`), 4 Matérn-5/2 ARD-GP local correction patches, independent out-of-sample audits, and 3-way 8D Stretch+GMM MCMC constraints.
